sloka: प्रसन्नस्ते पिता राम यौवराज्यमवाप्स्यसि ।उपवासं भवानद्य करोतु सह सीतया ॥२-५-९॥
transliteration: prasannaste pitā rāma yauvarājyamavāpsyasi ।upavāsaṁ bhavānadya karotu saha sītayā ॥2-5-9॥

translations.english: O Rama, welldisposed towards you, your father will declare you heirapparent. Do undertake fast today, along with Sita.
